
## Quick Guide - BNB Greenfield Develop
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-greenfield/for-developers/get-started-dev/

# Quick Guide - BNB Greenfield Develop

Quick guide for BNB Greenfield developers. Covers Greenfield and programmability concepts, uniform address format, account operation, data storage, permission control, enhanced permission control, and cross-chain programmability.

- Greenfield Overview: read the Greenfield introduction.
- Account operation: create an account, deposit BNB, and program token transfers with GO-SDK or JS-SDK examples.
- Data storage: create a public bucket to upload and share objects using CLI, GO-SDK, or JS-SDK.
- Permission control: create private buckets and share with specific individuals via groups.
- Enhanced permission control: create groups, add members, share private buckets, and manage resources with smart contracts.
- Cross-chain programmability: mirror resources from Greenfield to EVM chains and program resources through smart contracts.

Developer starter kit includes Greenfield Chain API, SP API, Go SDK, and JS SDK.

## MindPress Data Marketplace Introduction - BNB Greenfield
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-greenfield/for-developers/tutorials/app/data-marketplace/

# MindPress Data Marketplace Introduction - BNB Greenfield

MindPress Data Marketplace is a demo built on BNB Smart Chain and BNB Greenfield for image trading. It demonstrates BNB Greenfield V1.6 and V1.7 features such as cross-chain programmability, delegate upload, and sponsor-paid storage fees.

Sellers can upload images, list them for sale, and delist them. Buyers can search, buy, and download original images.

Key improvements:
- No network switching: all operations finish on BSC.
- Flexible payment: projects can pay storage and download quota fees.
- Easy upload: upload multiple large objects without signatures or fees via delegate upload.
- Easy listing: fewer transactions to list objects.

Technical design: buckets, objects, and groups can be mirrored on BSC as ERC-721/ERC-1155 tokens; smart contracts on BSC can control mirrored resources.

## BNB Greenfield
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-greenfield/

# BNB Greenfield

BNB Greenfield is a decentralized storage and blockchain storage solution for data ownership and data economy. It provides decentralized data management, access, and EVM programmability.

Main sections:
- Get Started: start the Greenfield journey.
- Build on Greenfield: start building dapps on data assets.
- EVM Programmability: create value from data assets.
- Greenfield Blockchain: explore main modules.
- Storage Provider: explore the Storage Provider.
- Developer Kit: official tool index for Greenfield, BSC, and opBNB.

## Storage Provider Lifecycle - BNB Greenfield SP
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-greenfield/storage-provider/storage-provider-lifecycle/

# Storage Provider Lifecycle - BNB Greenfield SP

Describes the lifecycle of a storage provider (SP) from joining the Greenfield Storage Network to exiting.

- Preparation: learn how to run and create an SP node, create required accounts, and run all SP services.
- Proposal: initiate an on-chain MsgCreateStorageProvider proposal with addresses, endpoint, quota/price, SP stake (1000 BNB testnet), and proposal deposit (1 BNB testnet).
- In Service: handle storage/retrieval, create virtual groups, and provide stakes for stored data.
- In Maintenance: do not serve create/upload requests. Status is changed with MsgUpdateStorageProviderStatus; restrictions apply based on maintenance duration and lockup blocks.
- Exit: graceful exit migrates data to successor SPs and returns staked BNB; forced exit is also possible.

## opBNB Deployment Configuration Reference
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-opbnb/advanced/opbnb-deployment-configuration/

# opBNB Deployment Configuration Reference

Example and field reference for creating your own opBNB rollup testnet. Use after completing build, account setup, and network configuration.

Includes a deploy config JSON example with L1/L2 chain IDs, sequencer and batch sender addresses, output oracle settings, gas limit, fee vaults, governance, fault proof settings, and DA settings.

Configuration tables cover:
- Chain configuration: chain ID, gas limit, RPCs, block time, withdraw time, batcher/proposer commit intervals.
- Gas fee configuration: L1 fee scalar.
- Governance configuration: governance token support, symbol, name, owner.
- Custom gas token configuration: token name, symbol, decimal, total supply.

## Creating Your Own L2 Rollup Testnet
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-opbnb/advanced/run-your-own-l2-with-opbnb/

# Creating Your Own L2 Rollup Testnet

Guide to creating your own L2 rollup testnet with the opBNB stack, powered by the bedrock version of the Optimism OP Stack.

Deployment architecture includes Sequencer, Proposer, Batcher, Bridge node, and RPC node. Uses L1 smart contracts from contracts-bedrock, op-node consensus client, and op-geth execution client.

Software dependencies: git, go, node, pnpm, foundry, make, jq, direnv, gcc, libc-dev.

Hardware requirements: 4x2 GHz CPU, 16 GB RAM, high-performance SSD for op-geth and 500 GB SSD for op-node.

Guide also covers BSC testnet node access and building the source code.

## Quick Guide - opBNB
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-opbnb/developers/quick-guide/

# Quick Guide - opBNB

Quick guide for opBNB developers. opBNB is a Layer 2 scaling solution for BSC powered by OP Stack and is EVM equivalent.

- Getting started: create a fullstack dapp on opBNB.
- Connecting: network information, RPC providers, wallet configuration.
- Tokens: testnet faucet and bridges; mainnet CEX withdrawal or bridges.
- Cross-chain interoperability: sending data between L1 and L2.
- Developer tools: explorers, SDKs, wallets, oracles, account abstraction, storage, and data analytics.

## Quick Guide - BNB Smart Chain (BSC)
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/bnb-smart-chain/developers/quick-guide/

# Quick Guide - BNB Smart Chain (BSC)

Quick guide for BSC developers. BSC is EVM-compatible, so existing Ethereum smart contract skills transfer.

- Connecting: network information, RPC providers, wallet configuration.
- Tokens: BSC testnet faucet; mainnet CEX withdrawal.
- JSON-RPC API: Geth-compatible JSON-RPC methods.
- Official Developer Kit: SDK cards, MCP, Ask AI.
- Developer tools: explorers, SDKs, wallets, oracles, account abstraction, storage, and data analytics.

## BNB Agent Studio Demo
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/developer-kit/bnbchain-studio/demo/

# BNB Agent Studio Demo

Out-of-date end-to-end walkthrough for the earlier Python, two-layer BNB Agent Studio. The shipped product is a TypeScript, single-runtime tool; use the Quickstart instead.

This walkthrough follows a weather-forecast seller on BSC testnet: install the CLI, scaffold the agent, set up a wallet, fund it, activate an LLM, run locally, negotiate a sale, register on-chain, and deploy.

## BNB Chain Skills
> Source: https://docs.bnbchain.org/developer-kit/mcp/skills/

# BNB Chain Skills

For AI agents integrating with BNB Chain. Covers how to connect to the BNB Chain MCP, install the BNB Chain skill, and check agent registration.

- Connect: run `npx @bnb-chain/mcp@latest`.
- Agent registration: mainnet at 8004scan.io, testnet at testnet.8004scan.io.
- Learn the skill: `npx skills add bnb-chain/bnbchain-skills`.
- Repository: github.com/bnb-chain/bnbchain-skills.
